<style id="mlx1014-glass-notifications-css">
/* Frosted glass notification system scoped to the existing components. */
#mlx-notif-panel{--mlxglass:#f9fcffe8;--mlxglass-border:#d5e2f0;--mlxtext:#192b47;--mlxsub:#5b708a;--mlxchip:#eaf2fc;--mlxshade:#ffffffbe;
 z-index:2147482800!important;position:fixed!important;top:var(--mlx-notif-top,82px)!important;right:22px!important;width:min(394px,calc(100vw - 26px))!important;
 max-height:min(72vh,calc(100vh - var(--mlx-notif-top,82px) - 14px))!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden!important;
 border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border)!important;border-radius:24px!important;padding:18px 15px 15px!important;
 background:var(--mlxglass)!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;box-shadow:0 22px 72px #102c5440,0 4px 15px #12284419!important;
 backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(150%)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px) saturate(150%)!important;animation:mlx1014-glass-appear .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.22,1) both;
}
body.mlx101-ui[data-mlx101-mode="dark"] #mlx-notif-panel,body.adc-dark-mode #mlx-notif-panel{
 --mlxglass:#1c2c42ed;--mlxglass-border:#5367817a;--mlxtext:#edf3fc;--mlxsub:#b8c9df;--mlxchip:#30445f;--mlxshade:#253a56bc;
 box-shadow:0 24px 75px #050c19a3!important;
}
#mlx-notif-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-panel-head{flex:none;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:0 2px 14px!important;border-color:var(--mlxglass-border)!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-panel-head h2{font-size:19px!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.45px}
#mlx-notif-panel button{font-family:'Segoe UI Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif!important;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s ease,background-color .23s ease,color .23s ease,border-color .23s ease}
#mlx-notif-panel button:focus-visible,.mlx-toast-host button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #548ecb!important;outline-offset:2px}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-notif-close{background:var(--mlxchip)!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;border:0!important;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-mark-read{background:var(--mlxchip)!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border)!important;border-radius:9px;font-weight:650;font-size:11px}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-tabs{flex:none;display:flex;gap:6px!important;padding:13px 2px 8px!important;border:0!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-tabs button{background:transparent!important;color:var(--mlxsub)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:10px!important;padding:9px 13px!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--mlxshade)!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #17284012}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-notif-search{display:block;flex:none;width:100%;min-height:35px;margin:3px 0 10px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--mlxshade)!important;border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border)!important;border-radius:11px;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;font-size:12px;box-shadow:none!important}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-notif-search::placeholder{color:var(--mlxsub)!important}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-notif-items{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;scrollbar-width:thin;padding:0 3px 4px 0}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card{background:var(--mlxshade)!important;border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border)!important;border-radius:15px!important;margin:7px 0 11px;padding:13px 12px!important;box-shadow:none!important;animation:mlx1014-row-in .28s ease both;align-items:flex-start}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card .mlx-nicon{width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;border-radius:11px;background:#dfeefa;color:#24567d;font-weight:750}
body.mlx101-ui[data-mlx101-mode="dark"] #mlx-notif-panel .mlx-nicon{background:#355475;color:#e9f4ff}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card[data-kind="warning"] .mlx-nicon{background:#f9e7d5;color:#975b32}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-body{flex:1;min-width:0}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card strong{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.35;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;display:block}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card p{font-size:11.5px!important;line-height:1.46!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;margin:4px 0 6px}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card small{font-size:10px!important;color:var(--mlxsub)!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-actions button{font-size:10.5px!important;line-height:1.2;min-height:27px;padding:6px 10px!important;border-radius:8px!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-open{background:#244b79!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #244b79!important;font-weight:650}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-mark{background:transparent!important;color:var(--mlxtext)!important;border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border)!important}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-date{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--mlxsub)!important;margin:15px 3px 6px}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-more{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;border:1px dashed var(--mlxglass-border);color:var(--mlxtext);background:var(--mlxshade)}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-empty{text-align:center;padding:27px 10px 30px;color:var(--mlxsub)}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-empty span{display:grid;place-items:center;margin:auto auto 9px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mlxchip);font-size:20px}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-empty strong{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mlxtext)}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-empty p{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mlxsub)}
#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-access{color:#bc5a44;font-size:11px}
#mlx-notif-panel #mlx-clear-history{flex:none;border-radius:9px;background:var(--mlxchip);color:var(--mlxtext);border:1px solid var(--mlxglass-border);margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;min-height:31px}
/* Compact, clickable, reference-inspired pill popups. At most two visible. */
.mlx-toast-host{z-index:2147482700!important;top:var(--mlx-notif-top,82px)!important;right:20px!important;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)!important;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 24px))!important;gap:9px!important;pointer-events:none!important}
.mlx-toast-host>.mlx-toast.mlx-pill-toast{pointer-events:auto!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:57px;padding:5px 7px!important;
 background:#f9fcfffa!important;color:#1c3555!important;border:1px solid #d9e5f2!important;border-radius:999px!important;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #112a4b30!important;backdrop-filter:blur(16px)!important;
 animation:mlx1014-pill-in .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1) both!important}
body.mlx101-ui[data-mlx101-mode="dark"] .mlx-toast.mlx-pill-toast{background:#233750fc!important;color:#f1f7ff!important;border-color:#526985!important}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-open{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0;flex:1;cursor:pointer;border:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:inherit!important;text-align:left!important;padding:4px 10px!important;border-radius:999px!important}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;flex:0 0 36px;background:#e0edfb;color:#265c93;border-radius:50%;font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
body.mlx101-ui[data-mlx101-mode="dark"] .mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-icon{background:#355779;color:#e1edff}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-copy{min-width:0;flex:1;display:block}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-copy strong{display:block;font-size:12px!important;color:inherit!important;margin:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-copy small{display:block;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4;opacity:.83;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-close{flex:0 0 26px;width:26px;height:26px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;opacity:.65;border-radius:50%;font-size:17px;cursor:pointer}
.mlx-toast-host .mlx-pill-close:hover{background:#8090a426;opacity:1}
.mlx-toast-host>.mlx-toast.mlx-pill-exit{opacity:0!important;transform:translateX(18px)!important;transition:opacity .22s ease,transform .22s ease!important;animation:none!important}
@keyframes mlx1014-glass-appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px) scale(.975)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes mlx1014-row-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes mlx1014-pill-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(22px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:680px){#mlx-notif-panel{right:9px!important;width:calc(100vw - 18px)!important;border-radius:18px!important;padding:13px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#mlx-notif-panel,.mlx-toast-host>.mlx-toast.mlx-pill-toast,#mlx-notif-panel .mlx-notif-card{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
